Container.Name: openamp-files
Container.Overview: File service for the OpenAmp Android app. Serves audio from the music share by Plex track id, and makes Opus copies with ffmpeg for the High, Medium and Low download settings. Every request is checked against Plex with the caller's Plex token.
Container.Requires: A Plex Media Server with a music library.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port the file service listens on. Point your reverse proxy at this.

Config.Name: Music share
Config.Description: Your music folder on Unraid. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Where the Opus copies are kept.

Config.Name: Plex address
Config.Description: Address this container uses to reach Plex. A LAN address is fine.

Config.Name: Path mapping
Config.Description: The music folder as Plex sees it, then =, then the folder as this container sees it. Find the Plex side in Plex under Manage Library, Edit, Add folders. Several pairs are separated by commas.

Config.Name: Cache size cap (MB)
Config.Description: The least recently used Opus copies are removed once the cache passes this size.

Config.Name: High bitrate (kbps)
Config.Description: Opus bitrate for the High setting.

Config.Name: Medium bitrate (kbps)
Config.Description: Opus bitrate for the Medium setting.

Config.Name: Low bitrate (kbps)
Config.Description: Opus bitrate for the Low setting.
